items.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Is Up 12.1% After Record AI Backlog Sparks Major Capacity Expansion
items.summary: In recent months, Super Micro Computer reported a record AI-focused order backlog, including over US$60.00 billion in new fourth-quarter orders, and began expanding global manufacturing capacity to produce more than 6,000 racks per month to support growing data center demand. items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: Paramount, Intel, Strategy, Critical Metals
items.summary: ↗️ Intel (INTC), Super Micro Computer (SMCI), Advanced Micro Devices (AMD): The AI trade continued to find strength, sending shares of chip makers, server designers and related companies higher. AMD closed above a $1-trillion market cap for the first time.

items.title: AMD, Intel, Meta, Warner Bros., Moderna, Grail, Strategy, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks advanced Monday as oil prices eased and investors turned their attention to this week’s United National General Assembly for potential signs of resolution to the conflict in Iran.  Technology stocks, and artificial-intelligence stocks in particular, traded higher after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent met with China’s vice premier He Lifeng and said the pair had agreed to an AI dialogue.  Micron Technology  added 2.7% and  Marvell Technology  rose 5.4%.

items.title: DELL Rides on Growing AI Clientele: Can the Stock Outpace SMCI & CSCO?
items.summary: Dell Technologies' AI customer base tops 6,500 as enterprise, sovereign and Neocloud demand fuels record orders and a $95B backlog amid tough competition.

items.title: Super Micro Computer Looks Very Intriguing Right Now
items.summary: Super Micro just posted a quarter that sent analyst price targets soaring and earnings estimates jumping by 30% in a single month, yet the stock still trades below those targets and insiders are quietly selling. The setup looks compelling until you dig into what management said about where those profits actually came from.

items.title: Tech Stocks Push S&P Back to Positive Territory for September
items.summary: The S&P 500 has swung back into positive territory for the month, thanks to a rally in tech shares today. Chip stocks, software firms, hyperscalers and shares of companies whose fortunes are tied to cryptocurrencies are all rallying in early trading.

items.title: The AI Trade Leads Today's Stock Market Rally
items.summary: Stocks climbed on Monday with tech leading the march higher as investors eyed the possibility of a U.S.-Iran deal. The Nasdaq Composite added 1.4% as the S&P 500 gained 0.9%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.
